name: Regulation of kidney size and metanephros development
rationale: All three members regulate kidney/metanephros growth and development, whereas confusables concern nephric duct and ureter formation, renal cell proliferation or nephron epithelial differentiation.

name: Iminoglycinuria from proline and glycine transporter defects
rationale: All members are transporter defects (SLC36A2, SLC6A20) causing iminoglycinuria/hyperglycinuria, distinguishing them from confusables on cystinuria, Hartnup disorder, hypouricemia or hexose transport.

name: RIG-I-like receptor antiviral signaling and coronavirus modulation
rationale: Members cover RIG-I/MDA5 sensing of dsRNA, its positive and negative regulation and downstream TRAF3/TRAF6 IRF and NF-kB activation, and unlike the closest confusables include SARS-CoV-1/2 modulation of this innate response rather than IRF3/IRF7 interferon induction.

name: Nucleoside transport and mitochondrial adenine nucleotide exchange
rationale: Members combine plasma-membrane purine/pyrimidine nucleoside transport (including nucleoside-analogue drugs and SLC29A3 disease) with adenosine/ADP interconversion and mitochondrial ADP/ATP transport, which C1 lacks, while C3/C4 lack the nucleoside transport.

core: MHC class II peptide antigen presentation
name: MHC class II peptide presentation with monocyte expression signatures
rationale: All members concern exogenous peptide loading and presentation on MHC class II, and the monocyte/antigen-presentation expression modules distinguish it from confusables that instead carry regulation, lipid/MHC Ib presentation or DC surface signatures.

name: RUNX1-centred transcriptional control of hematopoietic gene programs
rationale: Members are RUNX1 (and RUNX2/RUNX3 acting on RUNX1) control of myeloid, megakaryocyte, B-cell receptor and interleukin genes, whereas confusables carry non-hematopoietic RUNX1 targets (WNT, estrogen receptor, keratinocytes) or megakaryocyte development itself.

qualifier: with dietary hexose digestion and transport
name: Glycogen storage and dietary hexose digestion and transport
rationale: Members combine glycogen synthesis/breakdown and its storage diseases with carbohydrate digestion and intestinal/renal hexose transport, which C1/C4 lack, while C2/C3 lack the glycogen component.

name: Telomere maintenance including telomerase RNA Cajal body trafficking
rationale: Members cover telomerase extension, C-strand synthesis, capping, telomeric recombination and associated fork/R-loop processing, and the telomerase RNA/scaRNA Cajal body localization and folding members distinguish it from broad DNA repair confusables.

name: Toll-like receptor and NLRP inflammasome control of inflammatory cytokines
rationale: Members regulate inflammatory cytokine output through bacterial TLR2/4/5 sensing (LPS detection, MyD88/IRAK4 deficiencies) and NLRP1/NLRP3 IL-1 processing, which together separate it from confusables lacking inflammasomes or lacking TLR sensing (pyroptosis/AIM2/CASP4).

name: Inhibitory Fc and SIRP receptor tuning of antibody immunity
rationale: Members regulate antibody-linked effector responses via inhibitory Fc receptor and SIRP signaling restraining phagocytosis, neutrophil and B-cell receptor activation, unlike confusables centred on activating Fc-gamma signaling, ADCC and hypersensitivity.

name: Fas and TRAIL death receptor apoptosis in T-cell immunity
rationale: Members cover Fas/TRAIL-caspase-8 extrinsic apoptosis and its c-FLIP/BID regulation, and the T-cell, thymocyte, allograft and tumor-defense members distinguish it from confusables on TNF-driven necroptosis.

name: Monocyte, neutrophil and dendritic cell expression signatures
rationale: Members are mostly cell-type expression modules of monocytes, neutrophils and dendritic cells plus monocyte activation, whereas confusables carry DC/monocyte differentiation, lymphocyte surface signatures or lipid antigen presentation.

name: WNT ligand secretion and non-canonical Wnt/calcium signaling
rationale: Members cover WNT palmitoylation/secretion, Frizzled ubiquitination and internalization and the Wnt/Ca2+ branch, distinguishing it from confusables on canonical beta-catenin/DVL/destruction complex or Hedgehog signaling.

qualifier: TRiC chaperonin folding and proteasomal ubiquitination
name: Protein stability via TRiC chaperonin folding and proteasomal ubiquitination
rationale: Members regulate protein stabilization/destabilization through K48 ubiquitination and proteasomal degradation, and the TRiC/CCT folding members distinguish it from confusables on deubiquitination, stress granules or other RHOBTB cycles.

name: Nuclear pore export of mRNA and snRNP biogenesis
rationale: Members concern nuclear pore-mediated export of mature mRNAs and snRNAs with cap hypermethylation and snRNP assembly, differing from confusables on mRNA 3'-end processing, splicing or rRNA/tRNA export.

qualifier: TRP channel detection of heat, mechanical and acid stimuli
name: TRP channel nociception of heat, mechanical and acid stimuli
rationale: Members concern detection of noxious thermal, mechanical and chemical stimuli in pain perception, and the TRP channel, acidic pH and caffeine members distinguish it from confusables on K2P potassium channels, itch or fever.

name: Gluconeogenesis, fructose catabolism and glucose-6-phosphate handling
rationale: Members cover gluconeogenesis (alanine, oxaloacetate), fructose catabolism and its disorders, and glucose-6-phosphatase/glucokinase control of hepatic glucose output, unlike confusables centred on glycogen, glycolysis or glycerol/alditol metabolism.

qualifier: with sulfide oxidation and histidine catabolism
name: Cysteine transsulfuration, sulfide oxidation and histidine catabolism
rationale: Members center on cysteine/transsulfuration and sulfide-to-sulfate oxidation (with molybdenum cofactor for sulfite oxidase), and the histidine catabolism members distinguish it from confusables on selenium, vitamin B6 or phenylalanine metabolism.

qualifier: Notch O-glycosylation and heparan sulfate synthesis
name: Notch O-glycosylation and heparan sulfate proteoglycan biosynthesis
rationale: Members combine O-fucose/O-glucose glycosylation of Notch EGF and TSR domains with EXT-dependent heparan sulfate synthesis, distinguishing it from confusables on chondroitin/dermatan sulfate, somitogenesis or WNT secretion.

name: Extracellular matrix remodeling and ascorbate redox handling
rationale: Members loosely share extracellular matrix maturation and turnover (collagen crosslinking, basement membrane, hyaluronan degradation, stellate cell activation, ATS) with oxidative/ascorbate handling (dehydroascorbate transport, protein oxidation, arylsulfatase activation), unlike confusables on elastic fibres or collagen synthesis; the theme is weakly cohesive.

name: Misfolded protein quality control via ERAD and organelle-selective autophagy
rationale: Members concern recognition and disposal of misfolded proteins through ERAD regulation, ubiquitin ligases/DUBs and selective autophagy of ER, peroxisome, nucleus and endosomes, distinguishing it from confusables on aggrephagy and chaperone-mediated autophagy.

core: MHC class II peptide antigen presentation
name: MHC class II peptide presentation and its regulation
rationale: All members concern MHC class II peptide antigen processing and presentation, and the regulatory members (including negative regulation) distinguish it from the confusable carrying monocyte expression modules and from MHC class I cross-presentation.

name: Mevalonate isoprenoid and post-lanosterol cholesterol biosynthesis
rationale: Members span the mevalonate/isoprenoid diphosphate steps through lanosterol to cholesterol via Bloch and Kandutsch-Russell routes, distinguishing it from confusables on bile acids, dolichol or fatty acid metabolism.

name: TCA cycle with 2-oxoacid dehydrogenase complexes and CoA supply
rationale: Members cover the TCA cycle together with lipoylated PDH/OGDH/OADH complexes (DLD) and coenzyme A biosynthesis, which confusables lack in different combinations while they add ATP synthesis, Fe-S assembly or glycine/lysine catabolism.

name: Inhibition of growth factor-driven endothelial sprouting angiogenesis
rationale: All members restrain endothelial proliferation, chemotaxis and VEGF/FGF responses in sprouting angiogenesis, distinguishing it from confusables on positive angiogenic regulation or endothelial activation/apoptosis.
